decisions.rationale: Initial exploration across diverse alternative labels for s1, s3, and s6 while testing binary switches on s2, s4, and s5 to identify baseline sensitivity and promising search directions.
Config 3 achieved very low f1 with s1=B, s3=B. Meanwhile, low f2 requires configurations like 1 and 4. We test combinations of s1=B with s3=C or D, and vary other parameters to explore trade-offs.
s2=B strongly drives low f2 (<3100), while s1=B and s3=B/C provide very low f1. Testing combinations of s1=B, s2=B, s3=B with varying s4, s5, s6 to explore non-dominated trade-offs.
s2=A drastically reduces f1 while maintaining high f2, whereas s2=B yields low f2 (~3k). Combine s1=B, s2=A with varied s4, s5, s6 or test low-f2 baselines with s1=B,C to improve trade-offs.
s1=B and s3=B with s2=A achieve very low f1; testing whether combining s1=B, s2=B with optimal s4/s5 reduces f2 while keeping f1 competitive, and exploring other s6 settings.
Explore low f2 region around s1=C/E and optimize f1 by testing other s3/s6 labels, while checking s1=A and unexplored s1=D variants with low-f2 settings (s2=B, s4=A, s5=A).
Testing s1=B, s2=A with s3=B, s4=B, s5=B on remaining s6 values to optimize f1, and exploring s1=C/E with s3=D/C to improve low f2 frontiers.
Testing s6=E and s6=D on low-f2 baselines to push the extreme f2 front, and testing s3=E with s2=A/B to explore remaining s3 variants.
s6=D dramatically reduces f2 when s2=B (e.g. config 37 achieved f2=2176), while s1=C offers much lower f1. Evaluating s6=D across different s3 labels with s2=B could push the low-f2 Pareto boundary.
s6=D yields the lowest f2 values. Combining s6=D with low f1 configurations (s1=B, s2=B with s3=C or s3=B) and testing s1=A with s6=D can explore the middle-to-low cost trade-offs.
s3=E and s6=D provide strong reductions in f1 and f2 respectively. Testing combinations of s1=B,C with s3=E or s4/s5 variations under low f2 regimes to uncover trade-off improvements.
Combine low f2 settings (s6=D, s2=B) with low f1 labels (s1=B, s1=C, s3=C, s4=B, s5=B) to find intermediate Pareto points between ultra-low f1 and ultra-low f2.
s1=E with s6=D gives the lowest f2 values, while s1=B or C combined with s3=C/E/B produces low f1. We test unexplored combinations along these low-cost trade-offs.
Explores combining s1=B, s2=A with s6=D across untested s4/s5 variations, and evaluates s1=A, s2=A with s3=C or s3=E to uncover low f1/f2 trade-offs.
Testing s4=B s5=B on low f2 templates with s6=D to explore intermediate trade-offs between extreme f1 and low f2.
s6=D yields the lowest f2 values. Exploring s1=B,C with s3=E,D,A and variations in s4,s5 tests trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Test s1=D for Pareto frontier behavior with optimal s6=D, exploring low f2 regions with s3=C/D and low f1 with s3=E while varying s4/s5.
Testing s1=E,s2=A combinations with s3=D/B, and exploring s3=C variations to bridge non-dominated gaps between low f1 and low f2.
Testing s1=E, s2=A with s3=A to lower f1 near low f2 (~29k), exploring s3=C with s1=A/C variants, and investigating s2=A with s3=D/E on other sites.
Exploit the lowest f2 values achieved at s6=D, s3=C, and s2=B by testing untested s1 options or variations around low f1/f2 trade-offs.
Sample diverse values across unconstrained sites s1, s3, and s6 to explore different regions of the objective space and gauge primary parameter sensitivities.
s1=B with s3=C achieved lowest f1, while s6=D/C keeps f2 low. Test variations of s1=B and s3=C paired with lower f2 features (s6=D, s4=A, s5=B).
s6=D yields low f2 with s3=B (config 1), while s6=B yields extremely low f1 with s3=C (config 3). Testing s6=D and s6=C with variations of low-f1 sites explores optimal trade-offs.
s2=B dramatically reduces f2 while s4=B s5=A drastically minimizes f1. Combining s2=B with low-f1 features (s3=C, s4=B, s5=A) can potentially find non-dominated trade-offs.
Testing s2=B combined with s4=B, s5=A or variations in s1/s6 to discover low f1 and low f2 compromises around the Pareto frontier.
s2=B with s4=A yields small f2. Testing combinations of s1 (B, D, E) and s3 (C, B) with s4=A, s5=A/B and s2=B to trade off f1 and f2.
Test s1=D with s4=A, s5=A and s3 variants to minimize f2, and combine high-performing s3=E with s2=A or s2=B for intermediate trade-offs.
Testing s1=D, s2=A with low-f1 features (s3=C/E, s4=B, s5=A) to find intermediate trade-offs between f1 and f2.
Evaluate combinations pairing low-f1 labels (s1=B/C, s2=A, s4=B, s5=A) with s3=A to test for new trade-offs, and test s1=A with low-f2 settings (s2=B, s4=A, s5=A).
Evaluating s1=A with s4=B to find ultra-low f1 points, and testing s3=D configurations where s4/s5 are ignored to discover potential breakthroughs in the low-f2 or mid-trade-off regions.
Evaluating s1=A with s3=A and s4=A,s5=A tests whether low f2 combines favorably with lower f1 than D/B combinations, targeting the Pareto gap between f2=2752-3200.
Testing s1=A with s3=B/C/D under low-cost combinations to push the frontier near f1=78k, f2=2900, while exploring s2=A combinations with s1=B, s3=E to minimize f1 further.
Testing s1=A with low-f2 components (s3=B, s6=C/B) to push the lowest-f2 boundary while keeping f1 competitive.
Evaluating s1=A with varying s6 labels under low f2 settings (s3=B/D, s4=A, s5=A/B), and testing s1=C, s2=A combinations that minimize both f1 and f2 around the Pareto frontier.
Evaluating s6=E across promising low-f2 baselines to explore potential new trade-offs or further reductions in f2, while testing combinations of s1=A/C/D with low-cost components.
s6=E gives the best f2 across tests. Combining s6=E with top low-f1 branches (s1=B/C, s2=A, s4=B, s5=A) and exploring s1=A low-f2 variants to advance the Pareto front.

s6=E consistently reduces both objectives across topologies. Testing s6=E with optimal low-f1 combinations (s2=A, s4=B, s5=A) across unvisited s1/s3 variants, as well as low-f2 variants (s2=B, s4=A, s5=A).

s6=E consistently reduces f2 across models. Combining s6=E with top low-f1 configurations (like s1=B/C, s3=E/C, s4=B, s5=A) and low-f2 configurations (s1=D/E, s3=D/A) targets unexplored Pareto boundaries.
s6=E dramatically reduces f2 across all configurations. Evaluating unexplored low-f2 options with s3=D and s6=E, along with testing combinations around the extreme f1 boundary.
Exploit s6=E with s3=D and s2=A across remaining s1 levels (C, B, E) to probe optimal f1-f2 tradeoffs in the intermediate cost range, plus test s1=E with s3=B.
Initial exploration across major sites s1, s3, and s6 with single and orthogonal variations from baseline to identify directional trends in f1 and f2.
Test combination of low-f2 components (s6=A, s1=D) with s3 variations, and explore individual site effects of the high-throughput configurations (s1=B or s3=B).
s1=E and s6=A improve both f1 and f2 compared to baseline. Testing s1=E combined with s3=B (which strongly lowered f1 in config 10) and s6=A, exploring further gains on the low-f2 front.
s1=E and s3=B show strong reductions in f1 while keeping f2 very low. Testing unexplored s6 values (e.g. C, E) and alternate s3 settings with s1=E could push Pareto efficiency further.
Testing s1=B with s3=C/s6=A and exploring s4/s5 variations under s3=C to bridge Pareto points between f1~38k-53k and f2~2100-2500.
s1=B with s2=A dramatically minimizes f1, while s6=A yields the lowest f2. Exploring variations of s2=A across diverse s3, s4, and s5 settings to discover non-dominated trade-offs.
Test s2=A with s1=D to explore low f1/f2 tradeoffs; evaluate s4/s5 variations with s3=C to see if f2 improves significantly while retaining low f1.
Exploration around low-f2 region (s2=B, s6=A, s4=B, s5=A) testing alternative s1/s3 combinations, and testing s4/s5 variations under low-f1 conditions with s1=B, s2=A.
Testing s4=B s5=B and variations of low-f1 configs under s2=B and s2=A to explore intermediate trade-off regions and test if s5=B lowers f1 in low-f2 regimes.
Testing s1=C with low f2 features (s3=C, s4=B, s5=B, s6=A) and exploring s1=C/D combinations to bridge the trade-off gap between f1=78k-93k and f2=2.4k.
Testing s3=A and s3=D with s4=B, s5=B, s6=A under s1=E and s1=D/B to find low f1 and low f2 compromises.
Explores the frontier between low f1 and low f2 by testing untested combinations: s3=D/A with s4=A,s5=B, and testing s3=E under low-f2 settings (s2=B, s6=A).
Evaluating unexplored s4=A options under s2=B to test if they offer intermediate trade-offs between low f1 and low f2, plus checking s1=A,C combinations with s3=B.
Evaluating s1=C with s2=A and s4=A/s5=B, and testing s1=C with low f2 choices to potentially dominate Pareto frontiers between f1 and f2.
Testing s4=A s5=B under s2=B with low f2 sites to find intermediate trade-offs, and exploring unmeasured s1/s3 combinations with s2=A.

Testing s1=E across alternative configurations (such as s6 effects and unexplored low-f1 configurations) and s2=A with s3=B or variants to uncover non-dominated points between the high-f2/low-f1 and low-f2/high-f1 clusters.
Test s4=A s5=B on s3=B or low-f2 baselines to push Pareto frontiers, combining s1=D/E with optimal s6=A.
Investigate s1=E across unexplored combinations (such as s6=A with alternative s4/s5) and check s2=B with optimal low f2 settings like s3=B or low f1 s2=A combinations.
Testing s1=B with s2=A and varying s3 across untested labels with s4=B, s5=B, plus exploring s1=C to optimize f2 around 2400 while minimizing f1.
Test s4=A and s5=B on unexplored s1/s2 configurations to bridge low f1 with lower f2, and check s6 variations under top low-f2 regimes.
Evaluating s1=B, s2=A with s3=B, s6=A, exploring s4/s5 permutations around the lowest f1 front, and checking s1=D, s2=A, s3=C with alternate s6 options to push the trade-off.
Initial exploration across diverse alternative labels for high-cardinality sites s1, s3, and s6 while testing alternate values of binary sites s2, s4, and s5.
High f2 correlates strongly with s2=A or s4=B. Test s1=A and s1=E with low-f2 settings (s2=B, s4=A, s5=B) and varied s3/s6 to discover low f1 and low f2 combinations.

s2=A sharply reduces f1 while inflating f2, whereas s2=B yields low f2. Combining low-f1 features (s1=A, s3=A/E, s4=B) with intermediate s2 settings or testing s3=A with s2=B explores the Pareto trade-off.

s2=A drastically lowers f1 at the cost of f2, while s1=B and s3=E yield superior low-f2 baselines. Testing combinations of s1=B, s3=A/C/E with various s4, s5 settings will map the intermediate trade-offs.
s2=A drastically lowers f1 at the expense of f2. Testing s1=B (where s2 is ignored) with low-f1 features (s3=A, s4=B, s5=A, s6=A) may yield a superior trade-off point.
Exploit s6=A which yielded Pareto improvements (config 23: f2=2496). Test s1=A/C/D with s3=E, s6=A, and examine s2=B versus s2=A trade-offs around promising regions.
s6=A yields the best f2 values while s1=D and s1=E/B paired with s3=E offer strong low-f2 trade-offs. Testing s1=E with s3=E and s6=A, plus low-f1 configurations with s2=A.
Explores the low-f2 region by combining s1=D (best f2) with variations on s3 and s6, and probes the low-f1 region combining s1=A, s2=A with unexplored s3/s6 combinations.
Test s6 labels C and D on low-f2 archetype s1=D, s2=B, s3=E, and test s1=D on the extreme low-f1 corner (s2=A, s4=B, s5=A, s6=A).
Testing s2=A with s3=E to explore potential mid-range f1 improvements, and checking s1=E/C with s4=B, s5=A, s6=A to discover lower f1/f2 trade-offs.
Test s1=E and s1=C with s3=D/B to optimize f1 and f2 trade-offs near the extreme f1 boundary, and explore s1=E with s6=A in the low f2 region.
Investigate s1=E and s1=C with s3=C, s6=A to minimize f1 further, and test s1=E on the low f2 region (s3=E, s6=A with different s4/s5 combinations) to improve the trade-off.
Exploit s1=D with s3=E and s6=A which yielded f2=2112, varying s4/s5 to check interaction effects, or test s1=E/C in low f2 regions with s3=E, s6=A.
Combine low f1 from s2=A with unexplored s6 options, and test s1=B with s3=E under alternative s4/s5 combinations, to discover better trade-offs near the Pareto boundary.
Test s4=A and s5=A combinations with s2=B or s1=D/B to find intermediate trade-offs between low f1 and low f2, and check s5=B on low f1 configs.
Test s5=B with s4=B on promising Pareto frontiers, and explore D/B configurations with alternative s4/s5 combinations to improve f2 while maintaining low f1.
Test s5=B on promising low-f2 and Pareto-frontier regions: s1=E/A/C with s4=B, s5=B, and explore s1=D with s3=E, s5=A to push the extreme low-f2 frontier.
Testing s5=A under s3=E with low-f2 site configurations (s6=A, s1=D/B/E), and exploring s1=B with s4=B, s5=B, s3=D to bridge the trade-off gap.
Investigate s1=B, s3=E combinations where s6=A provides minimal f2, and check s5=A when s3!=E to lower f1 without inflating f2 excessively.
Explores the frontier between low f1 and low f2 by testing untested combinations of s4=A, s5=A on s1=A/C/E alongside Pareto-optimal s6=A, targeting intermediate trade-offs.
Initial exploration across major sites s1, s3, and s6 to uncover sensitivity and identify potential reductions in both f1 and f2 compared to baseline.
High f2 correlates strongly with s2=A or s5=B/s4=A. Configuration 3 has exceptionally low f1 (7252). Testing s1=B with the low-f2 pattern (s2=B, s4=B, s5=A) to find intermediate Pareto points.
Evaluating variations combining low-f1 features (s1=B, s2=A) with low-f2 features (s3=C, s4=B, s5=A) to find balanced compromises along the Pareto frontier.
s1=B and s2=A strongly reduce f1 while s4=A and s5=B yielded the lowest overall f1 (7252). Combining s1=B, s2=A, s3=E or s3=B with variations explores extreme low-f1 trade-offs.
Combine s1=B, s2=B, s3=E, s6=C with s5=B to explore better f1 while keeping low f2, and test s1=B, s3=E with s4=A and s5=B to optimize f1.
s2=B yields low f2 while s2=A lowers f1 dramatically. Testing s3=E or s3=B with variations in s1, s4, and s5 explores intermediate f1-f2 trade-offs and seeks improvements along the frontier.
s1=B with s2=A, s4=A, s5=B yields lowest f1 (~7k). Testing s6=C and s6=A/E may reduce f2 while keeping f1 minimal. Also exploring s1=C with s5=B for f2 minimization.
Test s1=A with s3=E to minimize f2 further, and explore s5=B on low f1 configurations (s1=C, s3=E) to bridge the Pareto gap.
s1=D, s3=E, s6=C gave the lowest f2 (2112) with s2=B. Testing other combinations with s3=E, s6=C, and exploring s1 choices alongside s2=B or s4/s5 variations to map the Pareto frontier.
Combine top low-f2 drivers (s1=D/C, s3=E, s6=C) with variations of s2/s5, and test s1=B with s3=D and s6=C to push the extreme low-f1 boundary.
Test s1=C and s1=A with s3=E and s5=B, or s1=D with s3=E variants, exploring combinations of s3=E and s2=B for lowest f2, and low f1 trade-offs.
Evaluating s1=D with s3=E and s5=B, alongside s1=C combinations with s3=E and varied s5/s4 to improve the ultra-low f2 region, plus exploring intermediate trade-offs between f1 and f2.
Testing s5=B on the best f2 frontier (s1=D, s2=B, s3=E, s6=C) and intermediate trade-offs with s1=D/B to find better trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Test s2=A with s3=E to explore the mid-f1 trade-off, and vary s4/s5 under s1=C/D to seek lower f1 at low-f2 boundaries.
Testing s1=A,B,D with s3=E variants or s2=B, s4=B, s5=A/B combinations to probe lower f2 regions, along with s1=E configurations at s3=D to discover potentially dominant intermediate trade-offs.
Test s1=E across lower f2 regions, explore s3=E with s5 variations in s1=D, and check untapped combinations around the Pareto boundaries.
Testing s3=E combinations with s2=B and s6=C on unexplored s1/s5/s4 variants to find lower f2 values, and s1=B, s2=A with s3=D to probe minimum f1.
Testing s5=B on low-f2 candidate s1=D,s3=E and exploring s1=C with s5=B to find lower f1 under low f2.
Testing s3=E combinations where f2 reached minimums (s1=D/C/A with s6=C). Also testing whether s1=C with s4=B, s5=B, s6=C improves trade-offs with s3=E.
Testing s5=B on s3=E configurations (where s4, s5 were previously ignored or untested) to probe further reductions in f2 alongside s1=D, C, A, and targeting lower f1 trade-offs.
Testing s1=C with s4=B, s5=B, s3=E to explore low f2/f1 trade-offs, and probing s2=A with s1=C to map unexplored low-f1 regions.
Evaluate combinations pairing promising s1 (D, C) and s3=A/D/E with unexplored s5/s6 settings to push lower f2 and expand intermediate Pareto gaps.
Test s1=D with s5=B, s6=C on s3=E to potentially break the f2 lower bound while keeping f1 competitive, along with exploring promising s3=E interactions with s2=A/B.
Test s1=D, s3=E with s5=B to potentially lower f2 beyond #37, and explore s1=C, s3=E with s5=B or s1=D, s2=A with s3=C/D variations for frontier improvements.
Test s1=D with s3=E and s5=B to seek lower f2 than run 37, and explore s1=D, s2=A, s3=A with s5=A to push the low f2 boundary under s2=A.
Test s1=E and s1=C with optimal trade-off features to bridge gaps in the Pareto front.
